title: ProductPrd:EnterpriseAccounting

_meta.purpose: Enterprise Accounting PRD: double-entry ledger, Korean VAT/K-GAAP/K-IFRS evidence, AP/AR/procurement bridge, close workflow, payroll posting, and audit-ready financial controls.

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure, root Makefile bootstrap/install/plan/apply targets, and oya ops surfaces; no manual SSH troubleshooting path

packs.notes: Korea-first HR/payroll/accounting fidelity: Labor Standards Act, 4대보험, HomeTax, K-GAAP/K-IFRS, PIPA, ISMS-P, SAPA, rules-of-employment and labor-management-council thresholds.
US expansion keeps payroll tax, benefits, FMLA/ADA/EEOC, GAAP, SOX-style controls, and multi-state employer obligations behind jurisdiction rulepacks.
EU expansion covers GDPR, works-council/local labor overlays, VAT, statutory accounting exports, and data-residency policy.

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: fiscal year vs calendar year period model
industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Sage Intacct — enterprise tenants may use non-calendar fiscal years (Apr–Mar, Jul–Jun)
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: FiscalCalendar entity per legal_entity_id; period open/close state machine operates on fiscal periods, not calendar months; KR default is Jan–Dec

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: fixed asset management: acquisition, depreciation, disposal
industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Sage Intacct — fixed assets are a statutory accounting requirement for K-GAAP/K-IFRS
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: FixedAsset entity with acquisition_cost, accumulated_depreciation, disposal_date; depreciation journal auto-generated per period close via rulepack (straight-line/declining balance)

industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Sage Intacct — deferred revenue and multi-element arrangements require standards-compliant recognition
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: RevenueArrangement entity with performance_obligation schedule; recognition journal auto-posted on obligation satisfaction event

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: bank reconciliation with bank feed integration
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Xero, QuickBooks Online — bank feed auto-match reduces reconciliation effort and errors
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: BankReconciliation entity per account per period; bank feed adapter consumes bank statement transactions; unmatched items surface in close checklist

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: accounts aging report: AR aging (30/60/90/120+ days), AP aging
industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct — aging is required for credit risk and cash flow management
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: AgingBucket projection computed from open Invoice entities; refreshed on-demand and at period close; aging breach triggers Workflow collection or payment escalation

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: dimension tagging: department, project, location, cost center
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Sage Intacct, NetSuite — segment reporting requires multi-dimensional GL
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: JournalVoucherLine carries dimension_tags map (department_id, project_id, location_id, cost_center_id); trial balance and reporting slice by dimension

industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite OneWorld, Sage Intacct — intercompany transactions must be eliminated to avoid double-counting in consolidated financials
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: IntercompanyElimination projection computed during group close; elimination entries posted to consolidation-only journal; never mutates entity ledgers

industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Sage Intacct — budget-to-actual variance is a standard management reporting requirement
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: Budget entity per legal_entity_id per period; variance computed as projection from trial balance; budget breach triggers Workflow approval for over-spend

industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Sage Intacct — external auditors require structured export of journals, balances, and supporting documents
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: AuditorEvidencePack entity produced at period close; includes trial balance, journal vouchers, statutory filing hashes, approval chains, and WORM digest manifest; SOC 2 control mapping included

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: manual spreadsheet close as production evidence
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: common SME/mid-market pattern: Excel close checklist accepted as audit evidence
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: close evidence must be typed, hashed, and WORM-chained; spreadsheet exports are read-only artifacts, not authority

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: posting to closed period without reversal workflow
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: NetSuite allows admin override of closed period posting without audit trail in some configurations
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: closed period posting requires Workflow-gated period reopening evidence; no admin override without audit chain entry

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: shared consolidated ledger across subsidiaries creates data integrity risk and compliance boundary violations
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: entity ledgers are immutable boundaries; consolidated view is projection-only, never mutated

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: payroll amounts posted to GL without linking to approved payroll run creates reconciliation dead ends
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: source payroll digest and approval evidence required on every payroll-origin journal voucher

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: revenue recognized without performance obligation schedule
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: ASC 606 / K-IFRS 1115 violations from recognizing revenue at invoice date rather than obligation satisfaction
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: RevenueArrangement entity enforces obligation schedule; recognition journal only posted on satisfaction event with evidence

AuditorEvidencePack produced within 24h of period close promotion; includes SOC 2 control mapping
FX rate snapshot on every JournalVoucherLine with foreign currency; revaluation journal at period close

best_practices: source digest for every imported posting
anti_patterns: posting to closed period without reversal workflow
manual shell workaround for missing close evidence

scalability.target: EnterpriseAccounting supports SME self-serve through conglomerate legal-entity groups without forked code paths

security.target: tenant, legal-entity, payroll, accounting, and evidence data remain RLS/policy isolated; privileged disclosure is audit chained

performance.target: operator hot paths p95 <= 200ms for preview and <= 150ms for GA under representative tenant shape

efficiency.target: unit economics tracked per employee, pay run, journal posting, evidence item, and workflow action

reliability.target: GA availability 99.95%; RPO <= 5m for professional data; rollback evidence emitted before root-cause analysis

user_experience.primary_navigation: suite shell with HR, Payroll, Accounting, approvals, evidence, and admin work queues; personal/work context boundaries inherited from the workspace shell where applicable

decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first enterprise children; suite model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.
